Package io.openlineage.client.utils

Class OneLakeLocation

java.lang.Object
io.openlineage.client.utils.OneLakeLocation
public final class OneLakeLocation extends Object
What is known about a location in OneLake, Microsoft Fabric's storage, and the fabric_onelake dataset facet built from it.

OneLake paths have the form abfss://<workspace>@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<item>/<section>/..., where the section is Tables or Files. This class reads the form written with IDs, d1f6473b-...@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/c7a14054-.../Tables/sales/orders. Every field is optional: each producer sets only what it knows locally, without calling Fabric.

    • parse

      public static Optional<OneLakeLocation> parse(String namespace, String name)
      Reads a OneLake location written with IDs from a dataset's namespace and name, such as abfss://<workspace ID>@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com and <item ID>/Tables/<table>.
      Returns:
      the location, or empty if this isn't a OneLake path that names an item by ID

      public Optional<DatasetIdentifier> guidIdentifier()
      The location written with IDs, as abfss://<workspace ID>@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<item ID>/..., with lowercase IDs and no trailing slash.
